properties.description: The workshop landing page with heading Make something by hand and Book a place button.
properties.expectation: The landing page visibly offers the printmaking workshop at $45 per person and a Book a place button.

properties.description: A booking form headed Book your workshop with Full name, Email address and Seats fields, a Review booking button, and NO Check your details error alert.
properties.expectation: The booking form has Full name, Email address and Seats fields and a Review booking button, with no validation error alert.

properties.description: The Book your workshop form displays a Check your details validation alert containing one or more field errors.
properties.expectation: The booking form remains visible with a Check your details alert explaining the invalid full name, email address and seat count. There is no booking confirmation.

properties.description: A Review your booking page shows name, email, seats, an AUD total, and Edit details and Confirm booking buttons.
properties.expectation: The booking review shows the submitted name, email and seat count, a total of $45 multiplied by the seat count, and Edit details and Confirm booking buttons.

properties.description: A successful booking page headed You’re on the list with a confirmation message and Start again button.
properties.expectation: A successful confirmation headed You’re on the list names the customer, correct number of seats and booking email, and offers Start again.
